An incomplete Navier-Stokes template `/home/user/Desktop/navier_stokes_base.py` is provided. Run your scripts with Python in the legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN 2019.1.0 environment (e.g. `from dolfin import *`). On this machine, run legacy FEniCS with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python` when working on `navier_stokes_base.py`.

Complete the following: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/ns.py`: - Define velocity space `P2` and pressure space `P1` (Taylor-Hood split) - Implement IPCS three-step scheme: - Step 1: solve tentative velocity `u*` (including convection) - Step 2: solve pressure correction `phi` (Poisson equation) - Step 3: correct velocity `u^(n+1) = u* - dt*grad(phi)` - Use a parabolic inlet whose centerline maximum is `U=0.3`, no-slip walls, and outlet pressure `0` - Viscosity `nu=0.001`, `dt=0.001`, run 50 steps from zero velocity and pressure 2. Extract and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Average x-velocity over the outlet boundary at `t=0.05 s` - Global maximum velocity magnitude, projected to scalar P1 Format: `outlet_velocity, max_velocity`
